Prebuilt native binaries for offline packaging
==============================================

This directory ships pinned, checksummed native binaries so that anyone can
clone the repo and build an installer WITHOUT downloading FFmpeg or libvlc
from the network. The packaging scripts restore these into the locations the
build expects, verifying SHA-256 before use.

> NOTE (P2-25, 2026-11-27): this repository uses sparse-checkout with
> `!/third-party/binaries/` plus an explicit `/third-party/binaries/SOURCE.txt`
> exception, so a normal clone checks out ONLY this manifest — the archives
> themselves stay out of the working tree. The promise "clone and package
> fully offline" only holds once the archives listed below are actually present.
> The Chinese section at the end documents the current per-platform status and
> how to verify / inject a checksum.

Files
-----

1) ffmpeg-macos-universal  (5.4 MB, universal: x86_64 + arm64)
   FFmpeg 8.1.3, LGPL-3.0-or-later (--enable-version3, no GPL/nonfree).
   Built with the exact configure flags in scripts/fetch-ffmpeg-macos.sh,
   x86_64 + arm64 slices merged with `lipo -create`.
   SHA-256: ec49289086ee9334cd33f83c24bd51b6d3907761dc3f13e379927916ecb5aadb
   Source tarball: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.3.tar.xz
   Source SHA-256: 7138d28c96d9d3e3af4ee3d8cad72741f8ffb40da90c1112235dea3ecd3178a3
   Used by: HLS (m3u8) remux to MP4, via external process (not linked).

2) vlc-3.0.21.dmg  (81 MB, universal: x86_64 + arm64)
   VideoLAN libvlc 3.0.21, LGPL-2.1-or-later.
   Upstream: https://get.videolan.org/vlc/3.0.21/
   SHA-256: 50380e56f81d630e3531426a265abf8b3dee6c0822bb7c9e30b532c7d69a65c0
   Used by: in-app media player (online playback), via vlcj dynamic loading.

Upgrade policy
--------------
When bumping FFmpeg or libvlc versions, update the pinned version + SHA-256 in
ALL of these places together:
  - scripts/fetch-ffmpeg-macos.sh  (FFMPEG_VERSION, EXPECTED_SHA256, PREBUILT_SHA256)
  - composeApp/build.gradle.kts    (vlcBundleVersion, bundledVlcSha256)
  - this file
  - THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md / resources/common/*/SOURCE.txt

Windows / Linux
---------------
Only macOS binaries are bundled here. Windows and Linux packaging still fetch
FFmpeg/libvlc from their pinned upstream sources on first build (SHA-verified).

=========================================================================
P2-25 补充说明：预置归档与 SHA-256 校验现状（2026-11-27）
=========================================================================

sparse-checkout 现状
--------------------
本仓库 `git sparse-checkout list` 为 `/*` + `!/third-party/binaries/` +
`/third-party/binaries/SOURCE.txt`：默认 clone **不检出本目录里的归档**，
工作区里只看得到这份清单（走查时工作区确实没有归档文件）。README 里
「clone 后直接打包即可，全程不联网」只在归档确实齐全时才成立；缺文件时
脚本会回退到联网下载 / 源码编译。请先用 `ls third-party/binaries/` 确认。

格式：<文件名>  SHA-256=<64 位小写 hex>  来源=<URL 或说明>

macOS（唯一随仓库分发的预置归档；SHA 同时写在 build.gradle.kts 的
       bundledVlcSha256 与 scripts/fetch-ffmpeg-macos.sh 的 PREBUILT_SHA256）
  vlc-3.0.21.dmg
      SHA-256 = 50380e56f81d630e3531426a265abf8b3dee6c0822bb7c9e30b532c7d69a65c0
      来源     = videolan 3.0.21 universal dmg
  ffmpeg-macos-universal
      SHA-256 = ec49289086ee9334cd33f83c24bd51b6d3907761dc3f13e379927916ecb5aadb
      来源     = 本仓库 scripts/fetch-ffmpeg-macos.sh 编译并 lipo 合并（2026-11-21）

Windows / Linux（本仓库不预置，走联网下载；没有内置期望 SHA）
  vlc-3.0.21.zip       SHA-256 = <未提供>  来源 = videolan 3.0.21 win64
  upx-4.2.4.zip        SHA-256 = <未提供>  来源 = UPX 4.2.4 win64
  vlc-3.0.20-2.jar     SHA-256 = <未提供>  来源 = Maven Central ir.mahozad:vlc-plugins-linux:3.0.20-2
                       ↑ 不是 3.0.21：vlc-setup 0.1.0 的 LinuxTasksConfigure.kt 把版本硬编成
                         "3.0.20-2"（作者留了 FIXME），落盘名与 vlcBundleVersion 无关
  upx-4.2.4.tar.xz     SHA-256 = <未提供>  来源 = UPX 4.2.4 linux
  ffmpeg-n*-win64-lgpl-*.zip
      SHA-256 = 见 scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.ps1 的 $ExpectedSha256（该脚本已强制校验）

联网下载的 libvlc 归档默认没有期望 SHA，composeApp/build.gradle.kts 的
verifyVlcArchive 会在打包前明确告警「本次未校验」，而不是静默跳过。
拿到官方归档后请自行计算并注入：

    ./gradlew -PvlcArchiveSha256=<sha256> :composeApp:packageReleaseDistributionForCurrentOS

或把归档与其 SHA 一并补进本目录和本清单，让离线预置路径也覆盖该平台。

升级任一二进制时必须同步更新：本文件、build.gradle.kts 的
vlcBundleVersion / upxBundleVersion / bundledVlcSha256、fetch-ffmpeg* 脚本里的
版本与 SHA 常量，以及 README 的对应说明。
